record.original_question: For systems x' = P_{2k+1}(x,y), y' = Q_{2l+1}(x,y), where P_{2k+1} and Q_{2l+1} are homogeneous polynomials of odd degrees 2k+1 and 2l+1, characterize which systems have a center and determine the maximum possible number of oscillations of the period function for those centers.

evidence.quote: Problem 13. (i) Characterize the centers of the above family. (ii) Which is the maximum number of oscillations of the period function for the centers of the above family?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider planar polynomial differential systems of the form
\[
\dot x = P_{2k+1}(x,y), \qquad \dot y = Q_{2l+1}(x,y),
\]
where $P_{2k+1}(x,y)$ and $Q_{2l+1}(x,y)$ are real homogeneous polynomials in $(x,y)$ of odd degrees $2k+1$ and $2l+1$ respectively, with $k,l\ge 0$ integers. Recall that a singular point $p$ of such a system is called a center if it has a punctured neighborhood entirely filled with periodic orbits surrounding $p$. The period function $T(\rho)$ assigns to each periodic orbit (parametrized by some transverse parameter $\rho$ on the period annulus) its minimal period; an oscillation of the period function is a (simple) critical point of $T$, and the number of oscillations is the number of such critical points.

(i) Characterize all systems in the above family that possess a center.

(ii) For the centers occurring in this family, determine the maximum possible number of oscillations of the period function.
artifact.category_tag: centers and period functions of planar polynomial vector fields
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returned no source giving a complete characterization of centers nor a determination of the maximum number of period-function oscillations for general planar systems with homogeneous nonlinearities of arbitrary odd degrees $2k+1$ and $2l+1$. Only partial results for specific small degrees (e.g., classifications of isochronous centers for degree 2, 3, 5 perturbations of a linear center, and three-parameter generalizations of Loud's systems) appear in the literature, suggesting the general problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: The period function of generalized Loud's centers
status_evidence.snippet: Three-parameter family of planar systems with homogeneous nonlinearities of arbitrary odd degree, extending Loud's systems.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results for specific subfamilies are known.

status_evidence.title: Isochronous global center of linear plus homogeneous polynomial systems
status_evidence.snippet: Only polynomial differential systems of odd degree can have an isochronous global center.
status_evidence.claim: Research is ongoing for odd-degree homogeneous systems with no general characterization of centers.

status_evidence.title: Criticality via first order development of the period constants
status_evidence.snippet: Number of simple critical periods provides the number of oscillations of the period function.
status_evidence.claim: General bound on critical periods for arbitrary odd-degree homogeneous systems is not established.
